description: This file is a shell script used for testing the migration of ref storage formats in a git repository. It defines functions and test cases for migrating refs between different formats ('files' and 'reftable'), verifying behaviors, error handling, and repository state after migration.

methods.name: print_all_reflog_entries
methods.description: Reads reflog entries for the main ref store in the given repository and outputs each reflog entry with a prefixed label.

methods.name: test_migration
methods.description: Performs the migration of refs in a given repository from one format to another, verifies the integrity and consistency of refs and reflogs after migration, and handles various options such as skipping reflog verification.
